G1050J.name: Gaius
G1050J.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1050J.brief: Recipient of John's third epistle; commended for his faithfulness.
G1050J.short: Gaius, the recipient of John's third epistle, was commended for his faithfulness to the truth and his hospitality to traveling missionaries.

G1050G.name: Gaius
G1050G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1050G.brief: Macedonian; Paul's traveling companion; caught in Ephesian riot.
G1050G.short: Gaius, a Macedonian and traveling companion of Paul, was seized along with Aristarchus during the riot in Ephesus.

G1050H.name: Gaius
G1050H.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1050H.brief: Derbean; accompanied Paul on his journey to Jerusalem.
G1050H.short: Gaius of Derbe accompanied Paul on his journey from Greece to Jerusalem, along with several others.

G1050I.name: Gaius
G1050I.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1050I.brief: Corinthian believer; host to Paul and the church.
G1050I.short: Gaius, a Corinthian believer baptized by Paul, hosted Paul and the whole church in his home.

G1058.name: Gallio
G1058.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1058.brief: Roman proconsul of Achaia; refused to judge Paul.
G1058.short: Gallio, the Roman proconsul of Achaia, refused to judge Paul when the Jews brought charges against him in Corinth.

G1059.name: Gamaliel
G1059.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1059.brief: Pharisee; teacher of the law; Paul's mentor.
G1059.short: Gamaliel, a respected Pharisee and teacher of the law, was Paul's mentor and advised the Sanhedrin to be cautious in their treatment of the apostles.

G1042.name: Gabbatha
G1042.brief: Raised stone platform in Jerusalem; location of Jesus' trial
G1042.short: Gabbatha, also known as the Stone Pavement, was the location in Jerusalem where Pontius Pilate sat in judgment over Jesus.
G1042.meaning: Aramaic for a raised place; John calls it “the Stone Pavement” (John 19:13)

G1053.name: Galatia
G1053.brief: A region in Asia Minor, recipient of Paul's epistle.
G1053.short: Galatia, a region in Asia Minor, was the recipient of Paul's epistle to the Galatians and was visited by Paul on his missionary journeys (<ref="Act.16.6; 18:23; 1Co.16.1; Galatians 1:2; 3:1; 6:18; 2Ti.4.10; 1Pe.1.1">Act.16.6; 18:23; 1Co.16.1; Galatians 1:2; 3:1; 6:18; 2Ti.4.10; 1Pe.1.1</ref>).

G1082.name: Gennesaret
G1082.brief: Plain on the northwest shore of the Sea of Galilee
G1082.short: Gennesaret, a fertile plain on the northwest shore of the Sea of Galilee, was the location of several events in Jesus' ministry.

G1086G.name: Gerasa
G1086G.brief: Region where Jesus healed a demon-possessed man
G1086G.short: Gerasa (or Gadara), a region southeast of the Sea of Galilee, was the location where Jesus healed a demon-possessed man.

G1068.name: Gethsemane
G1068.brief: Garden near Jerusalem; site of Jesus' prayer and arrest
G1068.short: Gethsemane, a garden at the Mount of Olives, was the site where Jesus prayed and was arrested before his crucifixion.
